title: Feed
summary: A feed: a scrolling column of entries read from the newest at the end -- a conversation, comments, an activity history, an audit log. Keeps the reading place while history is added above, follows the end only when the reader is there, «to the latest», asks once for earlier history, announces what is new once, draws a growing entry in place. The host draws each entry.

accessibility.focus: The scroller is a named, focusable region holding a log with aria-live off; one polite announcer says what is new once. «To the latest» moves focus to the last entry (the host's article, else the item). From a focused entry ArrowUp/ArrowDown move to the neighbour, Home/End to the first and last loaded; ArrowUp on the first asks for earlier history. Smooth scrolling follows prefers-reduced-motion.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-list-feed for any column the host feeds and a person reads from the newest at the end -- a conversation, comments, an activity history, an audit log -- when the reading position, history loading upwards and announcing new entries matter. For a list a person acts on (open, rename, row actions) use sf-list.
do_not: Do not fetch or poll from the element; the host owns the entries and every request leaves as an event
Do not pass markup as entry text; draw it in renderItem with your own sanitiser
Do not encode roles such as user and assistant into the feed: authors are data (author, own)
